package.name: g1_global_planner
package.description: 2D A* global path planner for the Unitree G1 in the humis-g1 stack: searches the fused costmap (/nav/costmap) for a collision-free, inflation-aware path from the robot to an RViz goal, line-of-sight smoothed, and publishes it as /nav/global_path for the local MPC planner.
package.author: Rohan
